title: Doctor модулей хаба по контракту check-result/v1: doctor --json у maind, analyst, harness; provides.doctor; порог Python из aicore.MIN_PYTHON; maind health --plan-repair и --apply-repair; редактирование секретов; tools_digest
summary: maind, analyst, harness печатают doctor --json как список check-result/v1 и текстовые строки <status> <check_id>: <observed>; unit.json объявляет проверки с output check-result/v1; порог Python во всех doctor (вкл. skiller) — aicore.MIN_PYTHON; maind health делится на --plan-repair (чтение) и --apply-repair, --fix — псевдоним; doctor ничего не пишет (тест снимка); секреты не печатаются (тест SENTINEL); maind.mcp печатает tools_digest; harness.hooks-env с repair.
why: D74, D25, E28, E30, R15/D35, R31; knowledge/hub-p11#e1e2. guidance:
Исполнитель: implementation/medium.

Порядок: maind doctor (проверки и `--json`, `tools_digest` из P11.10) → health `--plan-repair|--apply-repair|--fix` → analyst doctor → harness doctor (+ `harness.hooks-env`, `harness.safe-dirs`) → skiller порог → `unit.json` трёх модулей → тесты (схема, снимок, SENTINEL) → `scripts/test-python-floor.py` → golden → CHANGELOG → V1–V7.

validation.cmd: SB=$(scripts/dev-sandbox.sh new --name p11-skv-$$ | tail -1) && { scripts/dev-sandbox.sh run "$SB" -- bash packages/skiller/scripts/validate.sh; rc=$?; scripts/dev-sandbox.sh remove "$SB" >/dev/null; exit $rc; }

H=$(mktemp -d) && for m in maind analyst harness; do HOME=$H SKM_HOME=$H/skm packages/$m/bin/$m doctor --json > $H/$m.json; rc=$?; [ $rc -le 1 ] || exit $rc; done && PYTHONPATH=packages/aicore/lib python3 -c 'import json, sys; from pathlib import Path; from aicore.util import schema; reg, kind = schema.load_contract(Path("packages/aicore/schemas/check-result/v1")); docs = [(f, d) for f in sys.argv[1:] for d in json.load(open(f))]; assert all(json.load(open(f)) for f in sys.argv[1:]), "empty doctor output"; bad = [(f, d.get("check_id"), schema.validate(d, kind, reg)) for f, d in docs if schema.validate(d, kind, reg)]; assert not bad, bad' $H/maind.json $H/analyst.json $H/harness.json

! grep -rnE 'version_info >= \(3, 8\)|python3\.8\+|python>=3\.8' packages/*/lib && python3 -c 'import json; bad=[(m, d) for m in ("maind", "analyst", "harness") for d in json.load(open(f"packages/{m}/unit.json"))["provides"]["doctor"] if d.get("output") != "check-result/v1"]; assert not bad, bad'

bash scripts/test-integration.sh && python3 scripts/ecosystem-units.py check && python3 scripts/ecosystem-units.py render --check && python3 scripts/golden.py check && python3 scripts/public-hygiene.py && set -e; for t in scripts/test-*.py; do python3 "$t"; done
